remarks: Completely Renovated In-Town Gem  - Conveniently Located and Comfortable In-Town Living Welcome to this Charming Colonial, fully updated and conveniently situated in the heart of New Canaan. This lovely home offers four bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite, and an additional 4th bedroom with its own private entrance, providing ample space for any lifestyle.With four modern bathrooms and a 1-car attached garage, this property has been thoughtfully designed to cater to your every need. The fabulous location is a dream come true - just moments away from schools, the library, town center, restaurants, Waveny park, and YMCA.Step inside and be captivated by the stunning features. Hardwood floors add a touch of elegance throughout the home, while a fresh coat of paint brightens every room. Enjoy the convenience of a private deck, perfect for relaxing or hosting gatherings.The walk-up attic space offers versatility and additional storage options, ensuring that all your belongings have their designated place. Warm up during colder evenings by the fireplace in the spacious living room, or entertain guests in the large dining room with ample seating space.If that's not enough, you'll find even more storage solutions in the unfinished lower level, allowing you to keep everything organized and tidy.This in-town living experience in New Canaan is unparalleled - enjoy the best of the community without ever needing to drive. This beautiful home is move-in ready for you!
